file_write.scope: During normal execution, only scripts/normalize_clinvar_vcv.py may prepare one mode-0600 same-directory temporary file, link it create-new to the user-specified JSON report, and remove the temporary name. It may not replace a path, mutate an input, create directories, use the network, or start a subprocess. With --self-test only, it may create and clean one owned system-temporary fixture directory.
file_write.reason: The bounded helper publishes one provenance-bound normalization report through temporary-first create-new publication with rollback; replacement remains forbidden.

target_enforcement.openai: Allow only the explicit new local JSON report; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.claude: Allow only the explicit new local JSON report; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.generic: Run locally and allow only the caller-approved create-new JSON report.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit write approval is required for the new report path.
